answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy assigns every new identity a plume probation tier with a bond locked for 20 epochs. Two randomly selected auditors reproduce each task, and a failed audit burns 20 percent of the bond. A ledge quota limits each sponsor to two identities per epoch, while a juniper registry compares signed work fingerprints and quarantines correlated accounts. Full rewards unlock only after six clean rounds, so fake identities cost capital, time, and audit exposure; task hashes keep every decision verifiable.
